description: This file defines functions and schemas for fetching and parsing synthetic model data from an external API, including schema validation, price parsing, and model info transformation.

methods.name: parsePrice
methods.description: Parses a price string (e.g., '$0.00000055') into a number representing micro-units.

methods.name: parseSyntheticModel
methods.description: Transforms a SyntheticModel object into a ModelInfo object with computed properties.

methods.name: getSyntheticModels
methods.description: Fetches synthetic models from an external API, validates response, and returns a record of model IDs to ModelInfo objects.
